title: Oxydoo
description: An open-source tool written in Zig that makes Odoo development easier and adds oxygen to the developer workflow.
body: Oxydoo is a developer tool written in Zig, designed to streamline Odoo ERP development. It focuses on scaffolding, environment orchestration, and module workflows so engineering teams can spend more time building solutions.

title: Colox
description: An open-source app that helps you choose colors for your next project based on their emotional meaning.
body: Colox bridges color psychology and digital product design. Designers and founders can explore palettes based on the feeling they want a product to evoke, instead of choosing unrelated color values.

title: HUX.ai
description: An AI salesperson designed for the Algerian market to help businesses manage customer conversations and grow.
body: HUX.ai is an AI sales assistant built around the Algerian market. It brings product catalogs, local language needs, and order confirmation workflows together to help businesses automate customer conversion.
